related.title: Crew Dragon 載人太空船
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學目標 10 m/s 時 800 m² 案例不合格；不能由此替代實際載人返回認證。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: For a 10 m/s teaching target the 800 m² case fails; this cannot replace human-spaceflight return qualification. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 以相對運動模型計算偵測延遲與減速距離，區分絕對軌道速度。
related.differenceEn: Calculate detection-delay and braking distance in relative motion, distinct from absolute orbital speed.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學 m=9000 kg、g=9.81 m/s²、ρ=1.2 kg/m³、Cd=1.5、總有效面積 1200 m²。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：v=sqrt(2×9000×9.81/(1.2×1.5×1200))。 結果約 9.04157 m/s。穩態垂直下降 v=sqrt(2mg/(ρCdA))；忽略開傘瞬態、擺動與傘間干擾。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成相對速度 0.2 m/s、偵測延遲 3 s、減速度 0.01 m/s²。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：d=0.2×3+0.2²/(2×0.01)。 結果約 2.6 m。等加速度教學停止距離 d=vτ+v²/(2a)；忽略軌道耦合、姿態與推力延遲。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching m=9000 kg, g=9.81 m/s², ρ=1.2 kg/m³, Cd=1.5 and total effective area 1200 m². Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: v=sqrt(2×9000×9.81/(1.2×1.5×1200)). Result ≈ 9.04157 m/s. Steady vertical descent v=sqrt(2mg/(ρCdA)) excludes deployment transients, swing and canopy interference.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic closing speed is 0.2 m/s, detection delay 3 s and deceleration 0.01 m/s². Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: d=0.2×3+0.2²/(2×0.01). Result ≈ 2.6 m. Teaching stopping distance d=vτ+v²/(2a) assumes constant deceleration and excludes orbital coupling, attitude and thrust delay.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: FORMOSAT-5 福衛五號
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學目標 10 m/s 時 800 m² 案例不合格；不能由此替代實際載人返回認證。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: For a 10 m/s teaching target the 800 m² case fails; this cannot replace human-spaceflight return qualification. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 將影像尺寸、波段及量化位元轉為記憶體與下傳預算。
related.differenceEn: Convert image dimensions, bands and quantization bits into storage and downlink budgets.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學 m=9000 kg、g=9.81 m/s²、ρ=1.2 kg/m³、Cd=1.5、總有效面積 1200 m²。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：v=sqrt(2×9000×9.81/(1.2×1.5×1200))。 結果約 9.04157 m/s。穩態垂直下降 v=sqrt(2mg/(ρCdA))；忽略開傘瞬態、擺動與傘間干擾。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學影像 10000×10000 pixel、4 波段、每像元每波段 12 bit，以十進 MB 計。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：V=10000²×4×12/8/10⁶。 結果約 600 MB。未壓縮資料量=NxNy×波段數×每像元位元/8；未含封包、標頭與校驗。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching m=9000 kg, g=9.81 m/s², ρ=1.2 kg/m³, Cd=1.5 and total effective area 1200 m². Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: v=sqrt(2×9000×9.81/(1.2×1.5×1200)). Result ≈ 9.04157 m/s. Steady vertical descent v=sqrt(2mg/(ρCdA)) excludes deployment transients, swing and canopy interference.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching image is 10000×10000 pixels, four bands and 12 bits per pixel per band, in decimal MB. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: V=10000²×4×12/8/10⁶. Result ≈ 600 MB. Uncompressed bytes=NxNy×bands×bits/8, excluding packets, headers and checksums.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
